nodes.name: PLD PBSCF (100) on LAO (100)
nodes.procedure: Highly textured PBSCF thin films were grown onto single crystal LAO (100) substrates at 500 °C under an oxygen pressure of 10 mTorr with a KrF excimer laser of 248 nm wavelength at a pulse repetition frequency of 5 Hz and 10 Hz. After deposition, the thin film was cooled to room temperature at a cooling rate of 5 °C min⁻¹ under an oxygen pressure of 2 Torr.
nodes.source_text: Methods: Pulsed laser deposition. Highly textured PBSCF thin films were grown onto single crystal LAO (100)... cooled to room temperature at a cooling rate of 5 °C min⁻¹ under an oxygen pressure of 2 Torr.

nodes.characterization_summary: PBSCF thin films grown on LAO (100), (110), and (111) substrates exhibit highly textured surface orientations of (100), (110), and (111) respectively.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRXRD results showed that the PBSCF thin films grown by PLD were highly textured. ... PBSCF thin films grown on LAO (100), LAO (110), and LAO (111) have surface orientations of (100), (110) and (111), respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: All PBSCF thin films exhibit very smooth surfaces with surface roughness of ~0.5 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: All of the PBSCF thin films exhibit a very smooth surface with a surface roughness of ~0.5 nanometer.

nodes.characterization_summary: Surface composition of PBSCF thin films shows no noticeable differences between different orientations (Supplementary Figs. 4 and 5).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface composition of the obtained PBSCF thin films was probed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). No noticeable difference was observed in surface composition for the films with different orientations. (Supplementary Figs. 4 and 5).

nodes.characterization_summary: No significant change in surface morphology of PBSCF thin films observed even after long-term electrochemical tests.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM images verify that no significant change in the surface morphology of the PBSCF thin films was observed even after the long-term electrochemical tests.

nodes.characterization_summary: O 1s spectra fitted with peaks at 528.6 eV (Bulk-O), ~530.1 eV (-OH), ~531.2 eV (-COx), ~531.6 eV (Surface-O), ~533.3 eV (H2Oads); OH-/Olattice ratio follows (100)>(110)>(111) order.
nodes.evidence_snippet: All the O 1s spectra were fitted by five peaks, including bulk oxygen (Bulk-O) at ~528.6 eV, the hydroxyl group (-OH) at ~530.1 eV, hydrocarbon (-COx) at ~531.2 eV, surface oxygen (Surface-O) at ~531.6 eV, and water molecules (H2Oads) at ~533.3 eV... The OH-/O_lattice ratio followed the order of (100) > (110) > (111).

nodes.characterization_summary: After electrochemical tests, all PBSCF films remain highly textured with the same surface orientations as prepared.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRXRD results show that after the electrochemical tests, all of the films are still highly textured with the same surface orientation as prepared.
